turns.message: I ordered two gold Lakshmi coins on Myntra. They were priced at Rs.64,206, and shortly after ordering I saw a lower price of Rs.63,768, so I cancelled the first order and placed a new one at the lower price. The coins did not arrive by the promised delivery date. I communicated with Myntra but did not get a satisfactory response. Later they told me the order was cancelled and the amount would go to my store credit instead of being refunded to my bank account.

expected.rationale: No exact purchase, cancellation or return date is stated.
